Gland Pharma Q2FY27 results: Net profit rises 58% to ₹290.75 crore
items.summary:
Gland Pharma on Friday posted a 58.29 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 290.75 crore in the September quarter, driven by strong execution across businesses.
The company had reported a net profit of Rs 183.68 crore in the year-ago period.
The pharmaceutical company's revenue from operations rose to Rs 1,833.58 crore in the quarter under review from Rs 1,486.87 crore a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Total expenses also rose to Rs 1,471.69 crore in the July-September period from Rs 1,287.12 crore a year earlier, it said.
The company launched four molecules -- Sugammadex, Erythromycin, Fluorouracil and Atropine sulfate -- in the US this quarter, it said in a release.

Ather Energy shares fall 4%, snap 5-day gaining streak. What’s triggering the sharp fall?
items.summary: Shares of Ather Energy fell 4% to Rs 1,742 on the BSE on Thursday, ending a five-session winning streak as the shareholder lock-in period expired. The expiry releases shares held by investors under the lock-in that had been in place for around one-and-a-half years or longer.According to Nuvama Alternative & Quantitative Research, approximately 77 million Ather Energy shares will become eligible for trading following the expiry. These shares account for 21% of the company's total outstanding equity.The value refers to the total shares becoming eligible for trading as lock-up periods end. However, not all of these shares are expected to be sold in the secondary market, as a substantial portion remains held by promoter groups who typically continue to retain their stakes.Ather Energy Q2 snapshotLast month, the EV scooter-maker reported its first quarterly net profit of Rs 1.26 crore in the September quarter of FY27, marking a sharp turnaround from a net loss of Rs 154 crore in the year-ago period. The sharp turnaround was supported by a strong revenue growth of nearly 63% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 1,464 crore during the quarter under review.The company’s earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) turned positive at Rs 11.3 crore, against an EBITDA loss of Rs 133 crore a year earlier. The EBITDA margin stood at 0.77%. “We are not out of the woods. There is a lot of work for us to deliver on. The focus is on the top line. Improving volume will itself take care of operating leverage, if all the capacity work we are putting in bears fruit over the next few months. In the near term it can go up and down, but it is definitely worth celebrating this milestone for the business,” Tarun Mehta, CEO, Ather Energy, said.Nomura increased its target price for the shares of Ather Energy to Rs 2,070 apiece from Rs 1,926, while maintaining its ‘Buy’ rating. The international brokerage reaffirmed Ather Energy as its top pick in the two-wheeler space. It noted that the company’s industry-leading tech pack, improving reach, and product portfolio make it best-positioned to benefit from the EV inflection and resulting increase in EV salience of OEMs.Disclaimer: This article has been written by Veer Sharma, who is not a SEBI-registered Research Analyst or an Investment Adviser. items.summary: Shares of Pricol rallied 8.28% to Rs 732.60 during Thursday's trading session after the company reported a strong financial performance for the September 2026 quarter (Q2FY27), with healthy growth in both revenue and net profit.The company's consolidated net profit increased 33% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 85 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 64 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. Revenue from operations rose 35% to Rs 1,334 crore from Rs 988 crore in the year-ago period.H1FY27 financial performanceFor the first half of FY27, Pricol reported a consolidated profit after tax (PAT) of Rs 152.23 crore, registering a YoY growth of 33.68%. Revenue from operations during the period stood at Rs 2,417.60 crore, up 29.59% compared with the corresponding period last year.Business highlightsDuring Q2FY27, Pricol received several industry recognitions and awards, highlighting its operational capabilities, product development and customer relationships.The company was recognised as one of the "Iconic Brands of India 2026" at the ET Edge Iconic Brands of India Awards for its focus on customer trust, brand value and long-term stakeholder relationships.It also received the "Best Production Ramp-Up Support Award" from TVS Motor Company for its operational excellence and ability to support customer production requirements through cross-functional collaboration.Additionally, Pricol was honoured with the "Excellence in Indigenous Design & Parts Development" Award for FY2025-26 by Komatsu India Private Limited. The recognition was for the successful localisation of the 7-inch TFT cluster for the PC75/PC81 hydraulic excavator.Its subsidiary, Pricol Precision, received the "Valued Partnership for Support & Collaboration" Award from Ather Energy at the company's Annual Supplier Meet, acknowledging its contribution towards customer collaboration and partnership excellence.What management saidCommenting on the company's performance, Vikram Mohan, Chairman and Managing Director of Pricol, said the company remains focused on improving operational efficiency, maintaining cost discipline and enhancing productivity amid changing business dynamics and evolving market requirements.He added that Pricol continues to adapt its strategies to changing customer expectations and industry developments, with an emphasis on technological advancement, product development, quality and reliability. The company's priorities remain centred on agility, competitiveness and consistent execution to navigate changing business conditions.Pricol share price performancePricol shares have gained around 37% over the past year, while the stock has surged 105% over the last three years. The company currently commands a market capitalisation of approximately Rs 8,651 crore.  The stock's 52-week high stands at Rs 823.On the technical front, Trendlyne data shows that Pricol is currently trading above five of its eight simple moving averages (SMAs), indicating a positive trend across some key moving-average parameters.Disclaimer: The views/recommendations mentioned in this article, wherever applicable, are those of the respective SEBI-registered Research Analyst/brokerage and have been reproduced/reported with due attribution.
